title: Relief Extension Months for Larger Assistance Awards and Household Size
content:
Financial-assistance coordination standard — **Patient Payment Plans**: relief extension months for patients holding a larger award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program.

## The rule

A patient with an approved financial-assistance award of 50 percent or more and a household of 4 or more adds 2 relief extension months; a patient with such an award and a household of fewer than 4 adds 1 relief extension month; any other patient adds none.

Relief extension months are added to the installments still to fall due over which a relief installment spreads the plan's carried balance; months from every source are added together, and the installments with all the relief extension months never carry the plan past its 24th installment.

## Reading the assistance records

- **Approved award of 50 percent or more** — the patient's case under the Patient Financial Assistance Program whose status is approved, with an award discount percentage of 50 or more.
- **Household** — the household size recorded on that approved case.

## Months by award and household

| Approved award's discount percentage | Household size on the approved case | Relief extension months |
|---|---|---|
| 50 or more | 4 or more | 2 |
| 50 or more | 1 to 3 | 1 |
| below 50 | any | 0 |
| no approved award | any | 0 |

## Edge cases (hypothetical patients)

- A full-discount award, household of 4: 2 months.
- A 50 percent award, household of 3: 1 month — the award reaches 50 percent, the household does not reach 4.
- A 25 percent award, household of 6: none — the award is below 50 percent.
- An application still under review, household of 5: none — no approved award.
